1.label: very_easy
1.summary: Cross one slow road lane with short vehicles, one-tick hops, and eight allowed wipeouts.

2.label: easy
2.summary: Cross two road lanes and one water lane at reduced speed with long logs and six allowed wipeouts.

3.label: medium
3.summary: Cross two roads, one water lane, and one rail lane at moderate speed with five allowed wipeouts.

4.label: hard
4.summary: Cross the current six moving lanes with live collision, moving-log support, two-tick hops, and four allowed wipeouts.

5.label: very_hard
5.summary: Cross six faster lanes with longer road hazards, shorter logs, slower hop recovery, and two allowed wipeouts.
